status: integrated; measured narration; product review in progress

cues.title: 化石中的组合特征
cues.caption: 同一件化石：骨架与羽毛同时存在。
cues.captionEn: One fossil: skeletal and feather evidence together.
cues.zh: 羽毛只属于现代鸟类吗？看这同一件近鸟龙化石：骨架有恐龙的特征，前后肢旁又保存了羽毛痕迹。两类特征在一起，支持鸟类与恐龙的亲缘关系。这里是证据位置示意，并不证明这一个体就是现代鸟类的直接祖先。
cues.en: Do feathers belong only to living birds? Look at this one Anchiornis specimen: dinosaur skeletal features occur alongside feather traces around its limbs. Their combination supports a relationship between birds and dinosaurs. This diagram locates evidence; it does not establish this individual as a direct ancestor of living birds.

cues.title: 功能不同，骨骼关系仍对应
cues.caption: 先预测，再揭示鲸前肢的独立观察。
cues.captionEn: Predict, then reveal the whale observation.
cues.zh: 人的手臂和蝙蝠的翼，功能不同，骨骼连接却能对应：一根肱骨，接桡骨和尺骨，再接腕、掌和指。先遮住鲸的骨骼。如果这些前肢来自共同祖先，游泳的鳍里会保留什么？现在揭晓教材中的观察：连接依然对应，比例已经改变。猫的前肢也提供一份比较。这是多种观察共同支持的解释，不是现代动物互相变形。
cues.en: A human arm and a bat wing do different jobs, yet their bones correspond: one humerus, then radius and ulna, followed by wrist, palm and digits. Hide the whale bones. If these limbs share ancestry, what relationships should a swimming flipper retain? Reveal the textbook observation: corresponding connections, changed proportions. The cat adds another comparison. Several observations support this explanation; modern animals are not transforming into each other.

cues.title: 比较同源的发育结构
cues.caption: 比较同源区域，不是重演成体进化。
cues.captionEn: Compare homologous regions, not adult replay.
cues.zh: 胚胎图突出咽部和尾部。教材用鳃裂这一传统表述，但人的胚胎并没有长出能像鱼一样呼吸的鳃；更准确地说，是比较同源的咽弓、咽囊等发育结构。不同动物的胚胎也不是完全相同。发育相似性是证据之一，不是一个现代动物先变成另一个的过程。
cues.en: These embryos emphasize pharyngeal and tail regions. The textbook’s traditional gill-cleft wording does not mean a human embryo grows functional fish gills. The comparison concerns homologous pharyngeal arches, pouches and related structures. Embryos are not identical, and development does not replay a sequence of modern adult animals.

cues.title: 比较同一分子的差异
cues.titleEn: Compare differences in the same molecule
cues.caption: 同一蛋白的差异数：独立的一类证据。
cues.captionEn: Fixed counts for the same protein.
cues.zh: 再看教材给出的细胞色素c数据。与人的序列比较，黑猩猩没有氨基酸差异，猕猴有一个，表中另一些生物差异更多。这里展示的只是教材报告的差异个数，没有虚构具体替换位点。不能把单个蛋白的差异直接换算成精确分化年代，也不能靠它独自确定完整的进化树。
cues.en: The textbook compares cytochrome c with the human sequence. Chimpanzee has no amino acid differences, macaque has one, and several other organisms have more. We show reported difference counts without inventing specific substitutions. One protein alone does not determine a complete evolutionary tree or an exact divergence date.

cues.title: 环境改变，个体颜色保留
cues.titleEn: The environment changes; individuals retain their color
cues.caption: 背景改变，三只蛾的基因型保持。
cues.zh: 把同样的三种基因型放到不同树皮背景下。教材把黑色设为显性：两个显性等位基因，或显隐各一个，都呈黑色；两个隐性等位基因呈浅色。背景改变后，可见度与生存繁殖机会可能改变。每只蛾保留自己的颜色和基因型。选择影响已有变异的比例，并不是把每只浅色蛾改成黑色。
cues.en: Keep the same three genotypes on different bark. In this textbook model, two dominant alleles, or one dominant and one recessive allele, give a dark moth. Two recessive alleles give a pale moth. Visibility and reproductive success can change with the background. Each moth keeps its genotype and color. Selection favors existing variants; it does not rewrite each pale moth into a dark one.

cues.title: 用当年的总数重新计算
cues.caption: 11、22、63：数两份等位基因，而非只数黑蛾。
cues.captionEn: 11, 22, 63: count alleles, not just dark moths.
cues.zh: 从十、二十、七十只蛾开始。黑色两类每年增加百分之十，浅色减少百分之十。第二年是十一、二十二、六十三只，共九十六只。现在数显性等位基因：十一只各贡献两个，二十二只各贡献一个，共四十四个。所有等位基因共一百九十二个，频率约百分之二十三。这个教材练习直接更新基因型数量，没有另加随机交配假设。
cues.en: Start with ten, twenty and seventy moths. Both dark classes grow by ten percent; the pale class declines by ten percent. Year two gives eleven, twenty-two and sixty-three: ninety-six moths. Count dominant alleles: eleven moths contribute two each, and twenty-two contribute one each. That is forty-four among one hundred ninety-two, about twenty-three percent. This textbook exercise updates genotype counts directly, without an added random-mating assumption.

cues.title: 空白纸片与三个平行对照
cues.titleEn: A blank disk and three matched drug disks
cues.caption: 药物浓度与生长阈值共同决定空圈。
cues.captionEn: Concentration and growth threshold set the zone.
cues.zh: 虚拟平板保留教材的四个区域：一个空白纸片，三个相同抗生素纸片。模型让浓度随距离衰减，只有低于生长阈值的地方形成菌苔。三个纸片给出直径与平均值，但单位是模型长度，不是实测毫米。标出的R三是预先设定的耐受克隆，用来检验选择的逻辑。
cues.en: The virtual plate retains four textbook regions: one blank disk and three matched antibiotic disks. Concentration declines with distance; growth occurs below a stated threshold. We report three diameters and their mean in model units, not measured millimeters. R-three is a preassigned tolerant clone used to examine selection logic.

cues.title: 跟住被选中的克隆
cues.caption: 选择已有差异；普通对照不会自动变耐受。
cues.captionEn: Select existing variation; test the control.
cues.zh: 跟住原平板中的R三，再看由它的后代形成的新平板。这个假设模型里，较高的生长阈值使抑菌圈变小，随后保持，而不是每传一次就凭空变得更耐药。移除预设克隆，结果也会改变。真实纸片观察本身不能独自证明变异出现的时刻，需要其他实验与对照。
cues.en: Follow R-three from the original plate to a new plate formed by its descendants. Under this hypothesis, its higher growth threshold gives a smaller zone, which then stays stable. Resistance does not magically rise with every transfer. Removing the preset clone changes the result. Real disk observations alone do not establish when a mutation arose.

cues.title: 屏障先改变交流
cues.titleEn: A barrier first changes gene flow
cues.caption: 频率分化，不自动证明形成新物种。
cues.captionEn: Divergence alone does not establish a new species.
cues.zh: 河流把鼠群分到两侧，个体交流受到限制。我们另外假设两侧选择条件不同，计算一个等位基因的频率如何分开。这里没有把差异超过某个数字就直接判成新物种。地理隔离、遗传差异和生殖隔离是需要分别考察的事实，也没有一个统一的物种形成倒计时。
cues.en: A river divides the mouse population and restricts exchange. With an additional assumption of different selection on each side, one allele’s frequency diverges. No numerical threshold automatically declares new species. Geographic separation, genetic differences and reproductive isolation require separate evidence; there is no universal speciation countdown.

cues.title: 屏障消失，还要检验生殖
cues.caption: 还要检验：后代能否继续繁殖？
cues.captionEn: Test whether the offspring can reproduce.
cues.zh: 假设河流消失，比较两种待检验结果。如果仍能产生可育后代，交流可以恢复；如果已经有阻止可育后代产生的生殖隔离，地理障碍消失也不代表交流恢复。这是两种条件分支，不是同一群体在几秒内先恢复又突然失去繁殖能力。
cues.en: Suppose the river disappears. Two alternatives must be tested. If the populations still produce fertile offspring, exchange can resume. If reproductive barriers prevent fertile offspring, removing geography does not restore exchange. These are alternative outcomes, not one population gaining and losing fertility within seconds.

question.zh: 飞、游、抓握的前肢，为什么有相似的内部连接？
question.en: Why do wings, flippers and arms share internal connections?

lead.zh: 把化石、骨骼、胚胎与固定分子记录放在一起推理。
lead.en: Combine fossils, bones, embryos and fixed molecular records.

principle.zh: 共同由来使多个独立证据相互吻合；功能和比例仍可改变。
principle.en: Shared ancestry explains agreement among independent observations while proportions and functions change.

question.zh: 看不到内部的鲸鳍，你会预测什么？
question.en: What would you predict inside a concealed whale flipper?

explanation.zh: 预测相应骨骼连接，再对照独立观察；不能由单一相似性就断言直接祖先。
explanation.en: Predict corresponding bone connections, then test against an independent observation; one resemblance cannot establish a direct ancestor.

question.zh: 黑蛾变多，S频率就等于黑蛾比例吗？
question.en: Does a larger dark fraction equal the S frequency?

lead.zh: 追踪不变的三种基因型，再亲自数每个个体的两份等位基因。
lead.en: Track unchanged genotypes, then count two alleles per individual.

principle.zh: SS贡献两份S，Ss只贡献一份；用当年全部等位基因数归一化。
principle.en: SS contributes two S copies, Ss one; divide by all allele copies in that year.

question.zh: 两类深色和浅色都不增不减，S会改变吗？
question.en: If every class stays unchanged, will S change?

explanation.zh: 本模型保持20%；这是明确假设下的预测，不是所有真实种群的普遍结论。
explanation.en: The model retains 20%; this prediction depends on its assumptions, not a universal claim about natural populations.

question.zh: 抑菌圈缩小，是药物让每个细菌主动变强了吗？
question.en: Does a smaller inhibition zone mean every cell chose to resist?

lead.zh: 先解释浓度与生长边界，再跟住一个预存克隆的后代。
lead.en: Explain a concentration boundary, then follow a preset clone and its descendants.

principle.zh: 选择已有耐受差异可改变群体组成；圈径本身不证明变异何时出现。
principle.en: Selection can change an existing mixture; zone diameters alone do not establish when variation arose.

question.zh: 去掉预置R-3后，反复选择还会自动缩圈吗？
question.en: Without the preset R-3, must selection keep shrinking the zone?

explanation.zh: 不会。本模型不新增突变，普通克隆后代阈值保持；真实变异来源需要独立证据。
explanation.en: No. This model creates no new mutations and ordinary descendants retain their threshold; the origin of real variation needs separate evidence.

question.zh: 河流分开的两群鼠，何时才算有生殖隔离？
question.en: When do separated mouse populations have reproductive isolation?

lead.zh: 把地理屏障、频率分化与子代可育性分开检验。
lead.en: Test geography, allele divergence and offspring fertility separately.

principle.zh: 地理阻隔可能限制交流；生殖隔离需要独立生殖证据。
principle.en: Geography can restrict exchange; reproductive isolation needs independent reproductive evidence.

question.zh: 河流消失，频率差异仍大，就一定不能交流吗？
question.en: Does a large frequency difference prevent gene flow after reunion?

explanation.zh: 不能这样推断；需观察能否产生可育后代。示例中的两分支不由频率差值触发。
explanation.en: That does not follow; test fertile offspring. The two illustrated branches are not triggered by allele-frequency distance.

modelBoundaries: Fixed textbook molecular counts and limb observations are distinct from model-generated geometry.
Moth annual changes are textbook assumptions; no Hardy–Weinberg mating, drift or hidden mutation step.
Gaussian drug concentration is a normalized spatial snapshot; paper radius 8, no clinical unit or time inference.
Each clone inherits its threshold; ordinary S-0 is sampled at r45, tolerant R-3 at r32 in the same field. Daughter markers move around a viable annulus, not through an inhibited center.
A/B frequency divergence and fertility are separate inputs; the F1-sterility example does not exhaust reproductive isolation.
